With Infinite Scholar, his know when to turn loose damage is effectively doubled. His new base power reads: "Channel: The Scholar deals himself and 1 target X Infernal Damage, where X = the number of cards you've discarded since the end of your last turn plus 1."

Taking Sefirit's formula on the previous page:

Sefirit:

how about 3 of +1 healing and 3 of the turn healing into damage in play as well as the one that heals you for 2 at the start of the turn (I think it has some effect and then at the start of your turn heals for 2 and is destroyed.).  Thats 7 cards in play at the start of turn.  Also he needs to be down some Hp.

So start of turn he heals for 5 (2 base +3 total) and does 3 instances of 5 damage for 15.  Then he plays Know When to Turn Loose discarding 26 cards (he needed 7 in play, 6 to discard, and the KWYL itself) for 26 damage so he is up to 41 total.

Sefirit's total was 53, with a final heal for 4 = an additional 12 points of damage. BUT If his first heal got him to full health, Scholar of the Infinite can use his power phase to do an additional 30 damage to a single target. He wouldn't have been able to discard the full 26 cards, because then he'd take 33 damage and self destruct in the middle of his power phase. It would work out to be a total of 38 damage afterthe play phase with a 23 card discard from KWYL, and then Channel for 23 + 6 discarded for the forms +1 = 30 additional damage for a total 68.

(I'm assuming that because the text on his power mentions the Scholar first, that he's the first to take damage when using his power, and if he reaches 0, he can't finish the power due to being incapped, but this hasn't been established yet. If his power phase isn't interrupted by self damage, his Know When To Turn Loose with 39 cards can net him 79 single target damage with his power.)

Couple others looking through the list...

Expatriette: 21
Unload. Tactical Shotgun with Hollow Points for 6. Assault Rifle with Shock Rounds for 2 and 1. Submachine Gun and Shock Rounds for 1 and 1. Pride with Hollow Points and Incendiary Rounds for 5, and then Prejudice with Incendiary Rounds for 3. Then Load RPG Launcher for another 2.

If you use Prejudice first, and then Pride, you can then use Prejudice again (at least, it works that way in the app). Works out to the same amount of damage, though.

Now, with Dark Watch Expatriette, you can't get the RPG Launcher in, but Aim more than makes up for it. Unload, then Aim, Shotgun and Hollow Points (7), Assault Rifle (3) and Shock Rounds (2), SMG (2) and Shock (2), Pride with Hollow Points and Incendary (6) and Prejudice with Incendiary (4). Comes to 26.

Mr. Fixer: 9
Harmony, Pipe Wrench, Grease Monkey Fist in play (+3). Play Charge for 5, then Strike for 4.

There's a better way. With Duel Crowbars, Fixer can hit himself first then hit the villain and get the bonuses to stack up. So then it's

Charge (at Fixer) for 5, and hit the villain for 8; then Strike (at Fixer) for 4, and hit the villain for 7, a total of 15 to the villain.

Now, if you use Bloody Knuckles instead, let's see...

That means you can only use Strike once, but the first strike at Fixer is for 8 (+3 for the crowbars, harmony, and grease monkey fist, +2 for Bloody Knuckles' damage increase, +2 for Bloody Knuckles' increase of damage to Fixer) and the hit on the villain is 13.

This'd get a little more insane if you could have four sets of Bloody Knuckles' out, since it's not limited, but Fixer doesn't have any way to play additional cards.

Argent Adept: ...negligible.
Sorry, my head hurt too much. Too many fiddly stuff. Suffice it to say, he does very little for a lot of effort. if anyone wants to work this out, then please do so and I will update here.

Alright, I've done the math on this and it's actually a little frightening. The key is remembering that while you can only use each power once, you can use any of the Perform and Accompany effects as often as the instruments allow.

Okay, two copies of Scherzo, Syncopated Onslaught, Inspiring Supertonic and Alacritous Subdominant out and and Xu's Bell, Eydisar's Horn, Musaragni's Harp and Drake's Pipes.

Opening of the turn, Polyphoric Flare to Vocalize and hit Drake with Syncopated Onslaught. During the power Phase, Xu's Bell to activate Onslaught again and the Accompany of Subdominant to use another power (all the rest of this takes place while this power usage is being resolved, so the song card isn't destroyed until the very end). Use Eydisar's Horn to set off Scherzo (3 ice, 3 fire) and hit Subdominant again to use another power. Use Musaragni's Harp to activate Inspiring Supertonic's Perform to use Akpunku's Drum. Use that to set off the Accompany of Syncopated Onslaught (3 Sonic damage) and Scherzo again (3 ice, 3 fire). Musaragni's Harp still has an Accompany left, so use that on Alacritous Subdominant to squeeze one more power useage and blow Drake's Pipes to hit both copies of Scherzo (3 ice, 3 fire, 3 ice, 3 fire).

It works out to 27 damage.

We have a bunch of lovely new promos now.  Anyone want to see which heroes can get power boosts with them?

 

The most obvious is FV Tachyon: Instead of the 78 damage you get with regular Tachyon, or the 86 you could get from Super Scientific Tachyon, you get 101 damage.

Visionary Unleashed can have 8 ongoings in play.  So rather than 8 damage in her base form, she can deal 19 damage.

 

Captain Cosmic.  ugh.  First off, I've improved upon Natediggadoggity's 54 damage for regular CC.  Instead of playing Construct Cataclysm for his play, instead play Conservation of Energy destroying 3 constructs, (2 are brought back by 2 Sustained Influences), and then Harsh Offense hitting the unused Cosmic Crest for 2 and the last 2 Potent Disruptions for 5 each, and then Construct Cataclysm for 19.  That's 61 damage.  You can get to 63 if two of the in play constructs on top of the deck to get hit by Harsh Offense (you get +2 damage for each from Harse Offense, but -1 from Construct Cataclysm).  You can get to 65 if three more are on top of the deck (the net +1 per construct seen before, -1 for needing to destroy another construct for Conservation of Energy).  The third harsh offense pushes you to 67.  (Incidentally, there are exactly 9 constructs being used only for the Construct Cataclysm.  3 Energy Bracers, 3 Vitality Conduits, 1 Dynamic Syphon, 2 Cosmic Crests.  Even if we had more Harsh Offenses to play, they wouldn't be useful because we get more value from having the other constructs on the field)

Captain Cosmic.  ugh.  First off, I've improved upon Natediggadoggity's 54 damage for regular CC.  Instead of playing Construct Cataclysm for his play, instead play Conservation of Energy destroying 3 constructs, (2 are brought back by 2 Sustained Influences), and then Harsh Offense hitting the unused Cosmic Crest for 2 and the last 2 Potent Disruptions for 5 each, and then Construct Cataclysm for 19.  That's 61 damage.  You can get to 63 if two of the in play constructs on top of the deck to get hit by Harsh Offense (you get +2 damage for each from Harse Offense, but -1 from Construct Cataclysm).  You can get to 65 if three more are on top of the deck (the net +1 per construct seen before, -1 for needing to destroy another construct for Conservation of Energy).  The third harsh offense pushes you to 67.  (Incidentally, there are exactly 9 constructs being used only for the Construct Cataclysm.  3 Energy Bracers, 3 Vitality Conduits, 1 Dynamic Syphon, 2 Cosmic Crests.  Even if we had more Harsh Offenses to play, they wouldn't be useful because we get more value from having the other constructs on the field)

I think you still left a bit of damage on the table, and your changes (particularly when added to mine) are substantial enough that I figured they were worth writing out fully:

(Mostly due to Arcanis Lupus, Natediggadoggity, and/or Matchstickian)

In Play: 3xAutonomous Blade, 3xCosmic Weapon, 3xAugmented Ally, 2xDynamic Syphon, 3x Wounding Buffer (total of 14 constructs), 3x Sustained influence, Unflagging Animation, Destructive Response

Start of turn:

Augmented Ally: Cosmic Weapon->3

    3xAutonomous Blade Triggers->9

    Villain retaliates, triggering 3x Wounding buffer->15

Augmented Ally: Fabrication: Conservation of energy, destroying 3x Autonomous Blade, 2x Wounding Buffer 

    3xSustained Influence Triggers, returning 3xAutonomous Blade

    Destructive Response Triggers->16

        3xAutonomous Blade Triggers->22

        Hits Dynamic Syphon: Cosmic Weapon->25

        Hits Dynamic Syphon: Cosmic Weapon->28

    Play 6 cards:

        3x Harsh Offense each revealing 3 constructs->46

        3xPotent Disruption (3x Cosmic Weapon)->61

Unflagging animation Triggers (Cosmic Weapon)

Augmented Ally: Cosmic Weapon->64

Play Phase:

Construct Cataclysm (1xCW,1xWB, 2xDS, 3xAB, 3xAA)->74

Power Phase: pass

 

The extra damage comes from recycling your Autonomous Blade Triggers.  I'm not 100% certain this works.  I know from the video game that some cards that trigger "the first time [X happens] each turn" will trigger if X happens, then they enter play, and X happens again, even though it's not technically the first time, but I don't know if that's universal and I don't know if it works specifically for Autonomous Blade. However, if it does, this nets you an extra 6 damage.   I haven't looked at the variants yet, so I don't know if you can apply this technique to squeeze more damage out of them or not.

 

Edit: just realized that X on Consevation of Energy is one more than the number of constructs destroyed, so I destroyed one less, giving me one more from the Construct Cataclysm. This brings my total to 7 more than your 67.  I know that 6 of that is from the Autonomous blade recycle, but I'm not sure where that last one is from.  I think my math is right, though.  Maybe you forgot to use your last Sustained Influence, or possibly Unflagging animation? Also I see that your calculations for some of the variants include recycled Autonomous Blade triggers, so I take it that this does in fact work.

wow, you can keep this going for quite a while,  Using CoE to (better than) double your plays/draws, HO to clear your deck, deal damage and trigger refreshed ABs, and SI or CoE to give you extra draws to refresh your one-shots.  I don't think you can go infinite, but I think you can probably get more than 124 out of this.  I wonder if you can do better by playing CoE before Construct Cataclysm, then cyclying like this for a bit, then playing the Cataclysm as part of the CoE trigger to restart the cycle.  The possibilities get really complex here.

posts.cooked: Hm...  I think that Ra may have to be adjusted downwards.  While it's true that if Ra is fully set up with 2 Solar Flares, Imbued Fire, The Staff of Ra, Blazing Tornado, and Flame Barrier he can deal 33 damage in one turn, I don't think it's possible to reach that setup without aid from other players.  It takes two turns to play the Solar Flares, which means that Ra will be damaged by them 3 times.  Since Imbued Fire is out, they will boost themselves, meaning that Ra will take 8 and then 10 and 10 damage, which is 28 damage.  That in itself is survivable (barely), but Ra also has Flame Barrier out, which will damage him in response to each of those attacks.  And that makes him toasty.
